title: INFINIVERSE modpack
body:
INFINIVERSE Official Modpack

 

Welcome to INFINIVERSE — the official modpack for the INFINIVERSE multiplayer server (Fabric 1.21.4). This pack enhances the vanilla experience with voice chat, beautiful shaders, better animations, performance optimization, and more — all pre-configured for a smooth and immersive gameplay experience.

 

🔧 Features

 

🎙️ Voice Chat — Plasmo Voice
Proximity-based in-game voice chat with no external software required.

 

🕺 Emotes & Animations — Emotecraft, Player Animation Library
Custom emotes and smooth character animations to express yourself.

 

🎇 Visual Enhancements — Iris Shaders, LambDynamicLights
Full shader support and dynamic lighting for improved visual immersion.

 

🗺️ Navigation Tools — Xaero’s Minimap & World Map
Minimap and full world map with waypoint support.

 

⚙️ Performance Optimization — Sodium, Lithium, Distant Horizons
Increased FPS, optimized world loading, and far render distances.

 

🛠️ QoL Tweaks — Ok Zoomer, Mouse Tweaks, Searchables
Better zoom control, improved inventory interaction, and searchable containers.

 ✅ All mods are fully configured and compatible — no manual setup required.

 

🌐 Server Info

 

This modpack is required to join the official INFINIVERSE server.
It ensures a consistent, stable and upgraded multiplayer experience for all players.
